heading: Accounting expertise. AI tools. For firms that win on expertise and need their operations to keep up.
body: McCullough Clark is a Texas firm offering AI Operations Audits and monthly bookkeeping. We work with firms whose value is their expertise — and whose back office needs to match it. We identify where automation could meaningfully reduce manual work, then build the tools to do it. Founded by Sharla Clark, EA, MBA, and Whitney McCullough.
